falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $72,500 on any daily candle within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout above the August 2024 high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, which requires price to remain below prior resistance. This would suggest the bottom is already in and a new uptrend has begun, not a continued basing phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: Total crypto market cap (excluding BTC) gains more than 15% over any rolling 7-day period while BTC dominance drops below 48%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A broad altcoin rally with declining BTC dominance would indicate risk appetite has returned across the entire market, contradicting the HOLD signal which assumes continued risk-off conditions and BTC outperformance typical of bottoming phases.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rates on major perpetual exchanges (Binance, OKX, Bybit) flip positive and stay above 0.01% for 5 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistently positive funding would show leveraged longs are aggressively entering the market, indicating bullish sentiment and momentum. This contradicts the bottom_2024_aug pattern which requires capitulation and bearish positioning before a true bottom forms.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
